Run scripts from the repository root as `node scripts/<script>.js ...`. Before first use, install the local dependency with `npm install` inside `scripts/` (required by `convert-encoding.js` for `iconv-lite`). `sftp-sync.js` requires `psftp` on PATH and a populated `.vscode/sftp.json` generated from its template; first-time host-key acceptance must be done once via `echo y | psftp -P <port> <user>@<host>` before batch mode works.
